verdict.rationale: LM Studio documents a REST API (OpenAI-like) for interacting with local models from apps/scripts, plus a CLI (lms) and headless mode (llmster) for scripting/automation, giving AI-native users a documented public API surface. Community evidence corroborates the OpenAI-compatible server being used in real workflows. Missing for 10: independent third-party API reference docs beyond LM Studio's own site, and more detailed API endpoint/schema documentation in the evidence pack.
